acknowledging_pending_from_dev.from_dev_item: Check substrate narration of S.4a gate — coverage_progress=true semantics
acknowledging_pending_from_dev.validation_response: Without concept-db running (gap-001), substrate cannot reason categorically about coverage_progress. It can COMPUTE the boolean from cell-count monotonicity (the coverage-tick activity does this) but cannot DESCRIBE what coverage means as a learned property. The 3-window consecutive-progress criterion is in the coverage-tick template logic but not as a substrate-queryable concept. This is gap-001 in concrete form.
